d: Po, the Dragon Warrior, struggles to train a group of clumsy pandas in martial arts and prepare them to battle against Kai, an evil supernatural warrior.
A thief with a tragic past joins a band of adventurers in attempting to retrieve a lost relic. However, their quest goes awry when they cross the wrong people.
After an embarrassing defeat, a street dancer, Ash, assembles the best dancers from all across the world for another round against the Invincible crew.
While investigating a murder, Alex Cross learns of a ruthless serial killer. However, things soon spiral out of control, leading him on a quest for revenge and uncovering a dark web of conspiracy.

t: Shruti Hassan; The Love Laugh Live Show
d: The host invites prominent personalities and engages them in candid conversations about their personal and professional lives.
Necross, the former guardian of the sun, turns evil and steals it. Now, Mune, Glim and Sohone, three friends, must work together to retrieve it from him.
Michael Woods, a traveller and a parolee, picks up the wrong rental car to meet his wife which makes him the prime target of a group of corrupt police officers.
Rebecca Scott, a widowed reporter, teams up with an FBI agent to uncover the mystery of her husband's death. However, things take a turn when they are targeted by unknown enemies.
With the kingdom in need of a ruler after King Harold's death, Shrek embarks on a quest to find Arthur, Fiona's cousin, while Prince Charming plans to seize control of the throne.
Bruce Banner, a genetics researcher with a tragic past, suffers an accident that causes him to transform into a raging green monster when he gets angry.
Peter Parker faces Electro and his old friend who is dying and looks out for Spider-Man's blood in order to cure himself.
Bestowed with superpowers, Shazam and his foster siblings join forces against the daughters of Atlas who have stolen the Wizard's broken staff.
This powerful story of human courage and reconciliation in the face of titanic forces of nature, pits the world's most famous monster against malevolent creatures that threaten man's very existence.
An aspiring gangster pretends to be part of a notorious gang and tries to terrorise a neighbourhood. However, unknown to him, three martial arts experts live there and are ready to take him down.
Three minions embark on an adventure to find a new master. Chaos erupt when they decide to serve Scarlett Overkill, a super-villain who ploys to rule the world.
As a powerful crime lord threatens New York City, a team of mutant turtles trained in martial arts tries to leave their hidden lair to defend their beloved home from impending danger.
